title: AI Architect
job: Turn a broad idea into owned layers, decisions and a working journey.
steps: Bind the beneficiary, accepted outcome, existing repositories, measured machines and an explicit capital ceiling; unknown is a real value.
Compare the current stack, one simpler option and one bounded frontier experiment using dated primary sources. Keep one owner per durable workflow.
Compile the architecture pack, build in the existing product owner, and compare the same acceptance task before and after. Carry the source pack and actual test output.
quality: Can a different builder execute the handoff without guessing?
Do cost, residency and permissions survive every fallback?
Does the useful customer journey actually run?
native: Use scripts/architect.py and its existing manifest/schema. The suite handoff wraps the original pack; it does not replace it.

title: Agent Designer
job: Make an existing specialist measurably better at a bounded job.
steps: Demonstrate the gap using the current agent and a frozen task. Prefer improving an existing agent plus skill composition before adding an identity.
Define read/write scope, tool grants, input/output contracts, termination, recovery and shared parent budget. Keep personality separate from authority.
Run the native contract and gate checks. Test a useful result, a denied tool, wrong tenant and exhausted budget. Keep baseline/candidate outputs for independent review.
outputs: agent/skill design contract and activation prompt
quality: Does the proposed agent add a distinct capability?
Does a denied action remain denied after delegation?
Does the candidate improve accepted output per unit of cost?
native: Use the bundled design-contract schema and scripts/contract.mjs plus gate.mjs. A local gate is not a hosted sandbox.

title: Plugin Forge
job: Release a coherent suite with inspectable compatibility and rollback.
steps: Read the current release and preserve identity, scopes, app bindings and presentation. Map each specialist to a useful adoption task and its required host capabilities.
Run task fixtures, denied-input cases, two reproducible archives and clean extraction. Separate schema, native loader and actual host task results.
Save a guarded private update, read it back, compare changed bytes and report exact release IDs. Prepare public source, license, quickstart and rollback in the existing owning repositories.
quality: Can a fresh adopter run the example with documented prerequisites?
Are old app bindings and scopes preserved?
Can the previous source revision be restored?
native: Retain forge.py and official Plugin Creator update tooling. This handoff CLI neither saves plugins nor installs them.

title: Memory
job: Carry exact project context between specialists and hosts.
steps: Resolve the existing owner record and its revision. Keep the user's exact words, interpretation, source and expiry separate.
Bind tenant, brand, project and environment before retrieval or export. Preserve conflicts and predecessor references instead of overwriting an earlier verdict.
Use an admitted writer when available. Otherwise save a private pending handoff, verify original hashes, and demonstrate reopen on the destination. Do not label a handoff a canonical memory commit.
outputs: reopen evidence and pending writer state
quality: Was the same original wording recovered?
Did another brand's private record stay outside the handoff?
Can a reader distinguish accepted memory from a proposal?
native: Keep existing capture/resume/provision contracts. The generated starlight.memory.v1 is a manual platform projection, not local_core admission.

title: Marketing
job: Turn demonstrated product behavior into a measurable offer and launch.
steps: Select one to three bundled modules for the actual bottleneck: product-marketing/customer-research for fit, offers/pricing for the offer, launch/content-strategy for distribution, analytics/attribution for learning.
Bind every capability claim to a current artifact or demonstrated journey. Separate proposed pricing, target customers and targets from actual paid demand.

Produce a coherent page, teaching article, email and channel draft with a defined qualification event. Feed actual cohort observations back into one named experiment; keep unknown attribution unknown.
outputs: channel drafts with one qualified next action
quality: Can the reader try the claimed behavior?
Does every commercial promise have an owner and evidence?
Does measurement distinguish a visit, accepted artifact, repeat use and payment?
native: Keep upstream licenses and pinned module provenance. Use GenCreator launch.json for compiled launch output; the existing platform factory owns app-local execution.

title: GenCreator
job: Produce a finished edition and a source-backed launch around it.
steps: Resume existing CreatorPack and mission IDs; bind source rights, audience, medium and acceptance criteria. Keep the original and editing history.
Use existing commission, edition, operations and launch engines. Compare meaningful directions for the medium, render the actual result, inspect it at intended sizes and repair defects.
Compile launch drafts, preserve the exact digest, and obtain destination-specific review for publication. Carry the original edition, review evidence and launch packet into the suite handoff.
outputs: editable production source and rendered edition
launch.json and compiled unconfirmed launch packet
quality: Is the real artifact usable outside the launch story?
Does the edition preserve source rights and authorship?
Did the launch claim only what the edition demonstrates?
native: Use the existing local production and launch CLIs. Never self-confirm a launch digest or infer publishing permission from an integrity check.

title: Music Studio
job: Move a music idea through craft, listening and a recoverable catalog decision.
steps: Bind the work, artist-owned catalog, album world, exact prompt and desired audible result. Retrieve craft from Songcraft without copying private canon into a reusable package.
Keep prompt preparation, audio generation, blind listening and winner capture distinct. Give the critic actual audio; use score-first artifacts when that is the commission.
Preserve exact approved wording, lyrics, work/revision and listener verdict. Carry authorized original audio or a permitted reference, known rights and release-readiness gaps.
quality: Was the audio actually heard?
Is the approved prompt byte-for-byte recoverable?
Are composition, recording and distribution rights known?
native: Keep Songcraft and the configured music core as their existing authorities. An offline handoff does not render audio or establish a listening result.

title: Atlas
job: Make private project progress inspectable without duplicating its source.
steps: Retrieve the exact existing record and source revision; inspect retrieval coverage and timestamps before relying on a frontier brief.
Link source-owned decisions, artifacts, PRs and receipts into the existing project record. Use the actual update tool with its expected record version; reconcile a conflict before retrying.
Show one coherent project view: current useful result, evidence, gaps, responsible owner and next action. Keep a private draft when release authority or evidence is absent.
quality: Does every projected claim point back to its owner?
Did an update preserve the existing record identity?
Are preview, deployed and customer-validated states distinct?
native: Discover current Atlas tool schemas and use their native records. This envelope is attached evidence, not an Atlas API request body.

title: n8n workflows
job: Connect an inspected automation to a concrete platform outcome.
steps: Search for an existing workflow, inspect its current inputs, source revision, tools and side effects, and choose one durable owner.
Prepare a native execution request only after its actual authorization and resource bounds are known. Define idempotency, cancellation, retries, reconciliation and operator recovery.

Test the dry path and denied inputs. Execute only an authorized inspected workflow through the real tool and preserve the actual execution receipt; uncertain submission must be reconciled before retry.
outputs: native execution reference or explicit not-executed state
quality: Can a retry duplicate a paid or public side effect?
Does the tool's actual schema match the prepared request?
Is there one owner for durable state and recovery?
native: The handoff carries a workflow plan or receipt as data. It never activates n8n or replaces workflow approval.

title: FrankX AI Coach
job: Help a person adopt one useful workflow and learn from the result.
steps: Choose a real recurring task and record a baseline: accepted result, elapsed time, errors and review effort. Work with tools the person already has.
Run a bounded experiment with a clear artifact and recovery path. Explain the decisions in ordinary language, then give the learner a variation that tests understanding.
Compare the same task and record the person's actual observation. Promote a useful method into a reusable skill only when repetition warrants it; preserve private practice receipts.
quality: Could the person complete the variation independently?
Was the comparison made on the same task?
Are time savings observed rather than promised?
native: Keep the coach's existing private practice format. This handoff provides portability, not a learning credential or automatic recurring follow-up.
